responsibility: Implements object-file uniqueness tracking using filesystem inode identity rather than pathname text. It stores registered object descriptors in an index, opens candidate files, obtains their inode halves through `wrapc.fileinode`, compares them against previously recorded entries, and records new ones, supplying the gm2 driver with a way to detect duplicate object files even when they appear via different names or paths.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of ObjectFiles: it opens files, calls wrapc.fileinode, and records inode pairs in an index so duplicate objects are detected by physical filesystem identity, details not present in ObjectFiles.def.
